candidates.hypothesis: Long MNQ at the next 15-minute bar open after a clean GMM regime transition from Regime 0 (Bearish Chop) to Regime 2 (Bullish Drift) with no Regime 1 in the prior two bars, London session 03:00-08:30 ET (London Session Signal B, Mesfin 2026)
candidates.mechanism: Author's description: the directional move after a regime transition completes within the first post-transition bar; no economic mechanism tested
candidates.hold: 60 min or until 07:30 CT (08:30 ET), whichever first; 20-point fixed stop
candidates.best_source: Mesfin, Structural Limits of OHLCV-Based Intraday Momentum Signals in MNQ Futures, arXiv 2605.04004v3 (May 2026)
candidates.grade: working-paper (unreviewed arXiv preprint, single independent author; pointer-grade for design)
candidates.sample: MNQ 15-minute bars 2021-2025; walk-forward OOS 2023, 2024, 2025 Jan-Aug; N 247 OOS trades
candidates.post_2015_or_oos: yes: walk-forward OOS 2023-2025 (GMM refit per fold)
candidates.published_effect: walk-forward OOS mean net +4.09 NQ points per trade at 2.0-point round-trip friction; sd 14.97 points; T 4.30; win 61.54%
candidates.price_level_used: none needed (published in NQ points); paper notes MNQ 11,000-24,000 over the sample
candidates.dispersion: per-trade sd 14.97 pts; T 4.30; N 247; per-trade Sharpe 0.27 (paper); trades_per_year derived 247/2.67 yr
candidates.quote: Walk-forward OOS N 247 / Walk-forward OOS mean net return +4.09 pts / Walk-forward OOS std deviation 14.97 pts / Walk-forward OOS T-statistic (net) 4.30
candidates.quote_location: Table 11 (txt L470-L483); spec Table A2 (txt L700-L725); friction 'Friction 2.0 points round-trip'
candidates.decay_evidence: One-bar (15-min) delay flips the sign: 'A one-bar (15-minute) delay reverses T from +4.30 to -2.78' (Table 12). Earlier static backtest (N 289, T 5.15, net +5.77) superseded. No independent re-test.
candidates.data_needed: 1-minute OHLCV of NQ/MNQ incl. overnight session, aggregated to 15-minute bars; volume

candidates.prop_notes: Inside the Topstep day, flat by 07:30 CT so flat before 08:30 ET releases (P06-compatible by construction); 60-min hold, not HFT; overnight-session costs may exceed the day-session D8 round trip; idealized stop fills in the paper; one-bar delay sensitivity argues against manual entry

candidates.quote: most of the predictability in the return of the last half an hour stems from the last ten-minute period

candidates.why: Not proposable under V31/V38 (no published size); recorded because E20H6 exits 1-2 minutes before the close inside this window
